heard: Pluto has not finished a single orbit since its discovery. In February 1930, Clyde Tombaugh used a blink comparator to find the icy world at Lowell Observatory. Most people believe Pluto was a major planet for 76 years before its demotion. But this icy world is actually smaller than seven solar system moons, including Earth's moon. The International Astronomical Union demoted it in 2006 for failing to clear its orbital neighborhood. Pluto's path is so extreme that between 1979 and 1999, it was closer to the sun than Neptune. A single trip around the sun takes this world roughly 248 Earth years. Pluto will finally complete its very first orbit since discovery in the year 2178.
